subject: Banking
title: Insider Trading Scandals
description: A short lesson to help you apply Insider Trading Scandals.

hook.text: Raj Rajaratnam made $63 million trading on tips from Goldman Sachs board member Rajat Gupta. Both went to prison.

buildup.text: Insider trading means buying or selling stocks based on confidential information not available to the public.

discovery.text: Investment bankers know about deals before they are announced.

twist.text: The SEC uses phone taps, email surveillance, and pattern analysis to catch traders.

climax.text: Markets work only if outsiders trust the price; insider trading turns privileged access into the edge.

punchline.text: $63 million from insider tips. Both the trader and the tipper went to prison.

quiz.question: What is insider trading?
options: Buying or selling stocks based on confidential non-public information
